title: dep-scan mcp propose_triage input
description: The arguments of the propose_triage tool: one triage proposal, with who proposes it. The tool writes proposals only; it never sets an author or an approver, so the proposal changes nothing until a person runs depscan triage review. The server must have been started with --allow-propose.

finding.description: The dsf1 fingerprint of the finding the proposal is about, from list_findings or get_finding.

advisory.description: The advisory id, or one of its aliases, the proposal selects. Needs purl.

purl.description: The package the proposal selects, compared with comparable_purl. Needs advisory.

version_range.description: A vers range narrowing the purl selection, for example vers:npm/>=4.17.0|<4.17.21.

state.description: The proposed CycloneDX impact analysis state. not_affected needs a justification.

detail.description: Free-form detail about the proposal, including the evidence ids the reasoning cites.

expires.description: When the proposal should expire, as an RFC 3339 date-time.

proposed_by.description: Who proposes: the agent and its session, recorded on the entry so the reviewer sees it.

scan_dir.description: A scan directory inside the allowed roots whose recorded decisions file receives the proposal.

decisions_file.description: The decisions file to write into, inside the allowed roots. Takes precedence over scan_dir.
